decision: Drop of 60 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Engine (ICE) 5th Turbocharger (TC) 5th Exhaust Set (EXH) 5th Energy Store (ES) 5th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) 4th MGU-K 7th Power Unit Ancillary Component (PU-ANC)
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 (read with B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 60 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles B8.2.8a and B8.2.8b of the FIA F1 Regulations. The use of (Energy Store (ES) and Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) additional element(s) carries a 5 grid place penalty by virtue of Article B8.2.8b of the FIA F1 Regulations and the use of Engine (ICE), Turbocharger (TC), Exhaust Set (EXH), MGU-K and Power Unit Ancillary Component (PU-ANC) additional element carries a 10 grid place penalty by virtue of Article B8.2.8a of the FIA F1 Regulations. Therefore there is an accumulation of 60 places. Subject to Car 5 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 5 will be allocated a grid position in the Race in accordance with Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 5 Additional Changes To Pu Elements
